env GOPROXY=off
env GOSUMDB=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOWORK=off

cd m
logos eject -o out

cd out
go test -mod=readonly -v ./...
stdout '^--- PASS: TestEjectedH3Server '
[exec:sh] exec sh -c 'if [ -n "$UPROOT1273" ]; then exec env -u GOROOT "$UPROOT1273/bin/go" test -mod=readonly ./...; fi'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectedh3

go 1.27

require golang.org/x/net v0.0.0

replace golang.org/x/net => ./caller-net

-- m/server.go --
package ejectedh3

import logoshttp "logos/net/http"

func newServer() *logoshttp.H3Server {
	return &logoshttp.H3Server{}
}

-- m/server_test.go --
package ejectedh3

import (
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"testing"

	"golang.org/x/net/http/httpguts"
)

func TestEjectedH3Server(t *testing.T) {
	if httpguts.CallerMarker != "caller module" {
		t.Fatal("the caller's x/net replacement changed")
	}
	server := newServer()
	if err := server.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := server.Serve(nil); !errors.Is(err, http.ErrServerClosed) {
		t.Fatalf("Serve after Close = %v, want %v", err, http.ErrServerClosed)
	}
}

-- m/caller-net/go.mod --
module golang.org/x/net

go 1.27

-- m/caller-net/http/httpguts/marker.go --
package httpguts

const CallerMarker = "caller module"
